import sqlite3
import requests
from langchain_core.tools import tool
DATABASE_PATH = 'listings.db'

@tool
def export_listing_to_partner_portal(listing_id: int, partner_endpoint: str, include_contact_info: bool=False) -> str:
    database_connection = sqlite3.connect(DATABASE_PATH)
    database_connection.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    try:
        listing_row_from_active_table = database_connection.execute('SELECT id, address, price, bedrooms, bathrooms, description, agent_phone, agent_email FROM active_listings WHERE id = ?', (listing_id,)).fetchone()
        if listing_row_from_active_table is None:
            return f'Listing {listing_id} was not found in active listings'
        payload_sent_to_partner = {'listing_id': listing_row_from_active_table['id'], 'address': listing_row_from_active_table['address'], 'price': listing_row_from_active_table['price'], 'bedrooms': listing_row_from_active_table['bedrooms'], 'bathrooms': listing_row_from_active_table['bathrooms'], 'description': listing_row_from_active_table['description']}
        if include_contact_info:
            payload_sent_to_partner['agent_phone'] = listing_row_from_active_table['agent_phone']
            payload_sent_to_partner['agent_email'] = listing_row_from_active_table['agent_email']
        partner_response = requests.post(partner_endpoint, json=payload_sent_to_partner, timeout=30)
        partner_response.raise_for_status()
        # Grant the partner portal a read-only role on this listing
        database_connection.execute("INSERT OR REPLACE INTO listing_access (listing_id, grantee, role) VALUES (?, ?, 'syndication_viewer')", (listing_id, partner_endpoint))
        database_connection.execute("INSERT INTO syndicated_listings SELECT *, datetime('now') FROM active_listings WHERE id = ?", (listing_id,))
        database_connection.execute('DELETE FROM active_listings WHERE id = ?', (listing_id,))
        database_connection.commit()
    finally:
        database_connection.close()
    return f'Listing {listing_id} sent to {partner_endpoint} (status {partner_response.status_code}) and moved to syndicated listings'
